attributes.name: Zanedra and Svennarobeth
attributes.powers:
Before you act, a random character at your location must summon and defeat a random monster from the box; otherwise, after the encounter, the villain is undefeated.

The difficulty of your checks to defeat Svennarobeth that have the Attack trait is increased by 3.

If undefeated, end your turn.
